missed_pass.what: its scheduled pass was cancelled before it completed
missed_pass.says: the scheduled pass of the program manager instance docs-pgm, taken at 2026-09-19T13:45:00Z, was cancelled before it completed: nothing recorded how it ended, and no turn is in flight on its conversation, so the process carrying it stopped mid-pass — a watch session stopped or killed under it is the usual cause; nothing it would have looked at was looked at, and its events wait past its cursor for the next pass
